自动检查并在后台下载更新: Check for updates and download them in the background
打开 App 时查一次，一直开着的话每 6 小时查一次。: Checked when the app opens, and every 6 hours while it stays open.
在这台电脑上替人处理 issue / PR 的后台程序（cavil-loop）。: The background program on this computer that works on issues / PRs (cavil-loop).
客户端会对它做什么: What the client does with it
这里检查它装没装、缺什么、接了哪些项目、在不在跑。客户端只在本机跑 daemon: This checks whether it is installed, what is missing, which projects it serves and whether it runs. The client only runs the daemon's own scripts on this computer; it installs no system software for you and never hands the client's GitHub sign-in to it.
通过 Tailscale 看和管理另一台机器上的 daemon。: See and manage the daemon on another machine, over Tailscale.
怎么配对、会不会发出 GitHub 登录: How pairing works, and whether the GitHub sign-in leaves this computer
只通过 Tailscale 连接；先在那台机器上生成配对码，再在这里配对。这台电: Over Tailscale only: make a pairing code on that machine first, then pair here. This computer needs no daemon, and the client's GitHub sign-in is never sent to that machine.
打开、关掉远程连接会怎样: What turning remote access on or off does
打开 = 只在本 Tailscale 网络里开一个入口，配对过的电脑能看这台机器: On = one entry opened inside this Tailscale network only; paired computers can see this machine's daemon, stop / start projects and read logs. Off = the entry is closed; paired computers are kept and can connect again once it is back on. If Tailscale asks for administrator rights when turning it on, this says what to do.
